title: Introducing Equiano, a subsea cable from Portugal to South Africa
lineage: Original publication on the issuing organisation’s website.

passages.note: Google contracted Alcatel Submarine Networks in Q4 2018. The announced Portugal to South Africa system would use space-division multiplexing and switch capacity at the fibre-pair level. Google explained that pair-level switching would make capacity easier to allocate and reallocate at separate locations. The 2021 completion estimate was a forecast.
